title: 第5 章 瀚海森林第 6章 沐浴泰坦与龙之血
slug: 西幻从鹰人部落到天使帝国
content_zh:
披星戴月，日夜兼程！
七次太阳升起又落下。
跨过山川大河，深谷幽林。
姜尤终于带着自家的部落战士们来到了瀚海森林。
这是一片广袤浩瀚的森林，如同它的名字一般，绿意浩如瀚海，无边无际。
一条长河从这片森林中穿梭而过，汇入远方的大海之中。
这里是雷霆泰坦亚特里统治的领地边缘，与太古蓝龙王阿里勒托斯的领域接壤。
两者战斗了很多年，一直不分胜负。
此时的瀚海森林犹如一个巨大的兵营，费兰德万族皆有在这里出现。
他看到人马在森林中巡守，鹰人在天空盘旋，巨魔在丛林中扎营，矮人在山谷中骑羊，地精在砍伐树木，人鱼在大河前栖息，鱼人手持石叉，杂血巨人作为监军，妖精和树精在树梢上仰望，野猪人躺在大地上…等等。
这是泰坦一方的附属种族，泰坦巨人纪年以来，统治了半个世界的种族。
太古巨龙一方，并不逊色于泰坦巨人。
姜尤往瀚海森林的更遥远的北方望去，只见一座高达三百米的石头王座立在森林的北方。
如同用整座山凿成。
一位身高近两百米的巨人坐在其上，他紫发金眸，浑身散发着让人战栗的宏伟气息。
那威严如山如海，巨大的压迫感让姜尤惊叹！
每时每刻，都有通天彻地的紫雷闪电在他健壮的身躯上缭绕，如渊如狱！
“那是执掌雷霆的泰坦巨人，亚特里！”
按照第五篇章时代的说法，泰坦巨人生就传奇，成年后便能达到半神领域。
而伟大的泰坦之王，即便没有高举神座，也拥有媲美神灵般的伟力！

这就是泰坦巨人，半个太古费兰德世界的主人！
感受了泰坦巨人的伟岸气息，姜尤更加谨慎，穿越者的骄傲被他深埋心底。
他还是凡物，连超凡都不是，在这个充满超凡伟力，随时都会丧命的世界，唯有小心翼翼。
飞越过瀚海森林的空域，巡逻天空的鹰人和角鹰没有阻拦，让他们得以直接降落到鹰人聚集的营地。
刚一降落，便有鹰人王庭的士兵来到他们面前。
这是一个中年鹰人，身披狼皮，虽然没有超凡气息在身，却有身经百战的气场。
他淡淡问道。
“你们来自那个部落，头领是谁？”
姜尤站了出来，答道。
“王庭的长者，我就是头领，我们来自高蛮山部落。”
中年鹰人士兵淡淡地“嗯”了一声，显然没有听说过高蛮山部落。
他看了一眼姜尤他们携带的青铜兵器和甲，没有在意。
一支小小的部落鹰人，里面甚至还有女鹰人，有什么值得在意的呢？
“你们跟我来，东方来的鹰人部族由风翼大人统帅。”
中年鹰人士兵带领他们穿过半个营地，来到一处脏乱差的庞大营地。
这里的树木都被砍伐干净，留下一片空旷的泥土草地。
姜尤眼眸略微扫过，大致算出这里驻扎着一万左右的鹰人战士，灰黑的羽翼交错点缀在大地上，如同一张灰黑大网。
中年鹰人随意指了一个角落。
“你们就暂住在那里吧。”
说完便准备转身离去。
content_en:
Wearing the stars and the moon, traveling day and night!
The sun rose and set seven times.
Across mountains and rivers, deep valleys and secluded forests.
Jiang You finally brought his tribe warriors to the Hanhai Forest.
This is a vast and vast forest, just like its name, the greenery is as vast as the vast sea, boundless.
A long river passes through this forest and merges into the sea in the distance.
This is the edge of the territory ruled by the Thunder Titan Yatri, and borders the domain of the ancient blue dragon king Ariletos.
The two fought for many years, with no outcome in sight.
At this time, the vast forest is like a huge military camp, where all the tribes of Flanders appear.
He saw men and horses patrolling the forest, hawks hovering in the sky, trolls camping in the jungle, dwarves riding sheep in the valleys, goblins cutting down trees, merfolk perching in front of the river, murlocs holding stone forks, hybrid giants serving as supervisors, goblins and tree elves looking up from the treetops, wild boars lying on the ground... and so on.
This is a race affiliated with the Titans, a race that has ruled half of the world since the Titans began.
The ancient dragons are not inferior to the Titans.
Jiang You looked to the farther north of the Hanhai Forest and saw a stone throne three hundred meters high standing in the north of the forest.
It's like it was carved out of a whole mountain.
A giant nearly two hundred meters tall sat on it. He had purple hair and golden eyes, and his whole body exuded a terrifying aura of grandeur.
The majesty was as majestic as a mountain or the sea, and the huge sense of oppression amazed Jiang You!
At every moment, there are purple thunder and lightning that penetrate the sky and the earth, lingering on his strong body, like an abyss or a prison!
"That's the Titan who controls the thunder, Yatri!"
According to the time of Chapter 5, Titans are born legends and can reach the realm of demigods when they reach adulthood.
And the great King of Titans, even if he does not hold the throne high, still has power comparable to that of a god!
This is the Titan, the master of half of the ancient world of Ferland!
Feeling the majestic aura of the Titan, Jiang You became more cautious, and his pride as a time traveler was deeply buried in his heart.
He is still an ordinary thing, not even extraordinary. In this world full of extraordinary power and death at any time, he can only be cautious.
Flying over the airspace of the Vast Sea Forest, the eagles and horned eagles patrolling the sky did not stop them, allowing them to land directly at the camp where the eagles gathered.
As soon as they landed, soldiers from the Yingren Royal Court came to them.
This is a middle-aged eagle man, wearing wolf skin. Although he does not have an extraordinary aura, he has the aura of having experienced hundreds of battles.
he asked calmly.
"Which tribe are you from? Who is the leader?"
Jiang You stood up and replied.
"I am the leader of the elders of the royal court. We are from the Gaoman Mountain Tribe."
The middle-aged Eagle soldier said a faint "hmm", obviously he had never heard of the Gaoman Mountain Tribe.
He glanced at the bronze weapons and armor Jiang You and the others carried, but didn't pay attention.
There is a small tribe of hawks, and there is even a female hawk among them. What is there to care about?
"Follow me. The Yingren tribe from the east is commanded by Lord Windwing."
The middle-aged Eagle soldier led them through half of the camp and arrived at a huge, dirty camp.
The trees here have all been cut down, leaving an empty dirt meadow.
Jiang You glanced slightly and roughly calculated that there were about 10,000 Yingmen warriors stationed here. Their gray and black wings were crisscrossed on the ground, like a large gray and black net.
The middle-aged Eagle Man pointed to a corner at random.
"You can stay there temporarily."
After saying that, he was about to turn around and leave.
